AccountIn.title: AccountIn
AccountIn.description: A new account (spec §3.5); anything left out takes its default.

BarOut.title: BarOut
BarOut.description: Research prices: comparable across splits. None on a halted day.

BatchConfig.title: BatchConfig
BatchConfig.description: The source's configuration frozen for every segment; each run adds its own range.

ClassificationFingerprint.title: ClassificationFingerprint
ClassificationFingerprint.description: The TOPIX closes a discovery read (from its look-back start through the search end).

DayRecord.title: DayRecord
DayRecord.description:
One replayed session: the holdings' dispositions that morning's close,
the orders planned (as they ended), what filled or expired at its open,
the holdings the plan aims at, those held at the close, cash and NAV.

Distribution.title: Distribution
Distribution.description: Completed segments side by side, each weighing the same; nothing chained.

ExperimentDefaults.title: ExperimentDefaults
ExperimentDefaults.description:
For the registration form: every default, the trainers and their
parameters, the actions a contract may declare, and how far history
has been seen — what a contract registered now would freeze.

FiguresOut.title: FiguresOut
FiguresOut.description: Spec §7.4. Dividends and tax are not included.

OrderOut.title: OrderOut
OrderOut.description: An order or an account event (spec §3.6).

OrdersPageOut.title: OrdersPageOut
OrdersPageOut.description:
One page of an account's history, newest first. The groups do not
overlap: a skipped order counts as skipped, not as a buy or a sell.

Refusal.title: Refusal
Refusal.description: Why a request was turned away (FastAPI's `HTTPException` shape).

RegimeRules.title: RegimeRules
RegimeRules.description: The fixed classification definition; a change to it is a new version.

ReplayMetrics.title: ReplayMetrics
ReplayMetrics.description: Costs included; dividends and tax not.

ResearchHolding.title: ResearchHolding
ResearchHolding.description:
A holding at a replay's close, valued at that day's execution close:
a research run's at its end, a model experiment replay's at its end or
on any of its days. Named for research runs, which had it first.

SuggestedRulesOut.title: SuggestedRulesOut
SuggestedRulesOut.description: The portfolio rules the new-account page fills in for a strategy.

UniverseRule.title: UniverseRule
UniverseRule.description:
Where a universe's codes come from (spec §6.1). Each strategy
declares its own; the turnover floor and the tradable bar that day are
the same under either.

WarmupFollowsOut.title: WarmupFollowsOut
WarmupFollowsOut.description:
How a strategy's warm-up follows one of its window parameters: the
new-account page sets the warm-up to that parameter's value plus
`extra` whenever it changes, which is what the strategy checks.
